note: Every source that feeds this repository. A source enters automations/ only after it has been read, validated and attributed.

tiers.official: Published by n8n. Highest trust, authoritative for behaviour.
tiers.community-curated: Maintained by identifiable people, licence stated, workflows hand-picked.
tiers.aggregator: Bulk collections. Individually unverified; provenance often unclear. Research only, never bulk-imported.

sources.name: n8n documentation
sources.what_it_is: Reference for every built-in node, trigger and credential, including operation lists, parameters and common issues.
sources.quality_notes: Authoritative and actively maintained. App-node pages list operations but rarely every parameter; core and AI node pages are more detailed.

sources.name: n8n-io/n8n-docs
sources.what_it_is: The GitBook source behind docs.n8n.io, plus docs/_workflows — the real workflow JSON embedded in the documentation.
sources.quality_notes: Cleanest machine-readable path to the docs. Markdown pages carry frontmatter with canonical URLs; reusable snippets are unresolved includes, resolved by ID in this repository.

sources.name: n8n-nodes-base (npm)
sources.licence: Sustainable Use License v1.0 (.ee. files excluded)
sources.what_it_is: The built-in node package. dist/types/nodes.json holds the full node descriptions: parameter names, types, defaults, option values, displayOptions, versions, credential names.
sources.quality_notes: The only precise source for what workflow JSON accepts. Pinned at 2.15.1 in this repository; drifts with each n8n release.

sources.name: @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain (npm)
sources.what_it_is: The AI cluster nodes: agents, chains, chat models, memory, tools, vector stores, parsers.
sources.quality_notes: Same shape as n8n-nodes-base. Pinned at 2.48.3. These nodes connect with typed ai_* connections, not main.

sources.name: n8n workflow template library
sources.licence: Hosted by n8n; templates are contributed by named creators
sources.what_it_is: n8n's own template gallery — the library the Templates button inside n8n opens.
sources.quality_notes: Every template has a named creator and a last-updated date. The public API is not reachable from every network, so templates are referenced by URL rather than mirrored here.

sources.name: npm registry — n8n-community-node-package
sources.licence: npm registry metadata; each package under its own licence
sources.what_it_is: The keyword n8n itself uses when browsing community nodes. 14,543 packages carry it.
sources.quality_notes: Metadata only. Popularity is a weak trust signal — the top packages by downloads are mostly API wrappers with no review. Download counts come from api.npmjs.org.

sources.name: enescingoz/awesome-n8n-templates
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (per LICENSE file; GitHub reports NOASSERTION)
sources.what_it_is: About 280 workflow templates across 18 app categories, plus a category index.
sources.quality_notes: Widely used and the most cited collection. README carries affiliate sign-up links, disclosed as such. The author states no template was created by them, and individual templates remain under their creators' terms — so attribution per file is not available.

sources.name: felipfr/awesome-n8n-workflows
sources.what_it_is: Curated workflow JSON grouped by function: analytics, CRM, finance, HR, marketing, monitoring, security.
sources.quality_notes: Clear MIT licence and an explicit note that workflows were gathered from the internet and belong to their authors. Smaller and less active than the alternatives.

sources.name: Zie619/n8n-workflows
sources.what_it_is: The largest single collection, with a searchable web interface. README claims 4,343 workflows.
sources.quality_notes: Important caveat found during research: an independent audit reported that a large share of the JSON files replace AI nodes with n8n-nodes-base.noOp placeholders, so the AI steps do not work as advertised. The repository also does not attribute individual workflow authors.

sources.name: ScraperNode/awesome-n8n-templates
sources.what_it_is: Bulk template library claiming more than 13,000 workflows across 25 categories.
sources.quality_notes: Volume is the selling point and also the risk: no per-file attribution, no verification that a workflow imports or runs, and the count has changed repeatedly between README revisions.

sources.name: nusquama/n8nworkflows.xyz
sources.what_it_is: Catalog of n8n workflows with a browsable site.
sources.quality_notes: No licence stated, so nothing from it can be copied into this repository. Useful only as an index of what people build.

sources.name: 7and1/n8n-Library
sources.what_it_is: Frequently regenerated library of roughly 2,300 templates, mixing curated and community workflows.
sources.quality_notes: No licence stated and no per-file provenance. Regenerated in bulk, so file paths and contents change without notice.
